items.title: 11.3 Identifying Scalar and Vector Valued Functions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 289: 11.3 introductory text on the distinction between scalar and vector-valued functions

blocks.text: Ab tak humne dono qism ke functions ki definitions parh li hain. Is topic mein kitab sikhati hai ke kisi function ko dekh kar foran kaise pehchaanein ke woh scalar hai ya vector-valued. Yeh pehchaan pehle qadam par hi zaroori hai, kyun ke aage ka poora hal isi par depend karta hai.

Kitab kehti hai: scalar aur vector-valued functions ka farq samajhna calculus, physics aur engineering ki aage ki parhai ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Yeh functions un miqdaron ko bayan karte hain jo ek ya zyada variables, jaise time ya position, ke saath badalti hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Farq itna zaroori kyun hai? Output ki qism tay karti hai ke hum us ke saath kya kar sakte hain. Scalar function ko aam real function ki tarah jama, zarb aur differentiate karte hain, aur us ka derivative phir ek number hota hai. Vector-valued function ka har kaam component ba component hota hai, aur us ka derivative ek vector hota hai: 11.4 aur 11.5 mein position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ka derivative velocity vector banega, jis ki size bhi hai aur direction bhi.
Misaal se samjhiye: gari ka speedometer sirf number batata hai (60 km/h), yeh scalar hai. Lekin navigation app batati hai "60 km/h, shimal (north) ki taraf", yeh vector hai. Dono ka hisaab alag tarah hota hai.
Foran pehchaanne ka tareeqa: koi bhi hisaab karne se pehle output dekhiye. Ek real number aaye to scalar. Kai components aayen (\(\hat{i}, \hat{j}, \hat{k}\) ya angle brackets ke saath) to vector-valued.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Khud sochiye: \(p(t) = t^{3} - \sin t\) aur \(\mathbf{q}(t) = \langle t^{3}, \sin t\rangle\) mein kaun kya hai? \(p\) ek number deta hai, to scalar; \(\mathbf{q}\) do components wala vector deta hai, to vector-valued. Ajza (ingredients) same, magar output ki qism alag!

Agle page (11.3.1) par kitab dono qismon ki teen teen nishaniyan deti hai, aur har nishani ke baad ek misaal: ek temperature ka function (scalar) aur ek helix banane wala function (vector). Un misaalon se pehle yeh baat pakki kar lijiye ke faisla hamesha output dekh kar hota hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Scalar aur vector-valued dono functions aisi miqdaron ko bayan karte hain jo time ya position jaise variables ke saath badalti hain.
2. Output qism tay karta hai: ek number to scalar; vector to vector-valued.
3. Qism hi calculus tay karti hai: vector-valued function ka derivative bhi vector hota hai (velocity, 11.5).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Input dekh kar qism ka faisla karna: kitne variables andar gaye, is se farq nahin parta; sirf output dekhna hai.
2. Vector-valued function ko ek number samajh lena, jaise us ke components ko jama kar dena.
